about: The painted backdrops, four to a generated sheet. tools/backdrop_prompts.js turns this into prompts.md; tools/cut_backdrops.py cuts each sheet into <id>.webp. The ids match src/backdrops.js.

scenes.name: Sunny Meadow
scenes.scene: a sunny meadow on a spring morning
scenes.ground: short green grass with a worn dirt path
scenes.behind: rolling green hills, wildflowers, a small pond and a few round trees in the middle distance, soft clouds in a pale blue sky
scenes.right: the trunk and low branches of a leafy tree
scenes.avoid: ducks or birds on the pond

scenes.name: Cottage Kitchen
scenes.scene: a big, cozy cottage kitchen, seen from floor level
scenes.behind: a long wooden counter with jars and a bowl of tomatoes, copper pots hanging on the wall, a window with checked curtains looking onto a garden

scenes.name: Toy Attic
scenes.scene: a tidy attic playroom under a sloping wooden roof
scenes.ground: wide wooden boards with a round woven rug
scenes.behind: shelves of building blocks and picture books, baskets of folded blankets, a round window letting in soft sunlight
scenes.right: a coat rack with a scarf
scenes.avoid: brooms, balls of yarn, jigsaw puzzles or dolls

scenes.name: Windy Hilltop
scenes.scene: a grassy hilltop high above the clouds on a breezy day
scenes.ground: the flat grassy top of the hill, with a few smooth stones
scenes.behind: a sea of fluffy white clouds below, distant blue mountain peaks, a few kites far away in a clear sky
scenes.right: a wooden fence post with a fluttering ribbon

scenes.name: Pumpkin Farm
scenes.scene: a pumpkin farm in the golden light of late afternoon
scenes.ground: soft brown earth between the rows
scenes.behind: rows of pumpkins and tall corn, a red barn and a windmill in the middle distance, a warm hazy sky
scenes.right: a wooden fence with a gate
scenes.avoid: scarecrows, goblins or wheels of cheese

scenes.name: Castle Hall
scenes.scene: the great hall of a friendly castle
scenes.ground: smooth gray flagstones with a long red carpet running across
scenes.behind: tall arched windows letting in soft daylight, colorful banners, a throne on steps far back
scenes.left: a stone pillar with a hanging shield
scenes.right: a tall potted plant beside a pillar
scenes.avoid: suits of armor, knights, treasure chests or dragons

scenes.name: Swamp Bridge
scenes.scene: an old stone bridge at the edge of a misty swamp
scenes.ground: the flat, mossy stone deck of the bridge, seen from the side, with a low stone railing
scenes.behind: still green water with lily pads, reeds, drooping willow trees, soft mist

scenes.name: Crystal Temple
scenes.scene: inside an ancient temple built into a crystal cave
scenes.behind: carved sandstone columns, a wide doorway up a few steps, purple and blue crystals growing from the cave walls, a glimpse of desert sky through an opening above
scenes.avoid: statues, sphinxes, dragons or bright glowing crystals

scenes.name: Seaside Cove
scenes.scene: a sandy cove by the sea on a bright summer day
scenes.behind: gentle turquoise waves, a rocky arch out in the water, a white lighthouse on a far headland, a few puffy clouds
scenes.right: a stack of weathered rocks with seaweed
scenes.avoid: crabs, coral, shells, boats or umbrellas

scenes.name: Mushroom Forest
scenes.scene: a shady forest glade full of giant mushrooms
scenes.ground: soft mossy earth with a few fallen leaves
scenes.behind: huge spotted mushrooms of different heights, tall mossy tree trunks, ferns, soft beams of sunlight through the leaves
scenes.right: a thick mossy tree trunk with shelf fungus
scenes.avoid: fairies, helmets, houses in the mushrooms or glowing mushrooms

scenes.name: Frozen Lake
scenes.scene: a frozen lake in a snowy pine forest on a clear winter day
scenes.behind: snowy pine trees, distant white mountains, a small wooden cabin with a snowy roof far away, a pale blue sky
scenes.right: a snowdrift over rocks hung with icicles
scenes.avoid: snowmen, ice crystals, armor or footprints

scenes.name: Candy Hills
scenes.scene: a land made of sweets on a bright, cheerful day
scenes.ground: a flat, wide path of pale pink frosting
scenes.behind: rolling hills of chocolate and whipped cream, lollipop trees, a gingerbread cottage far away, pastel cotton-candy clouds
scenes.right: a tall stack of colorful macarons
scenes.avoid: gingerbread people, witches, or faces on the sweets

scenes.name: Grand Library
scenes.scene: a grand old library with towering bookshelves
scenes.ground: a polished wooden floor with a long patterned rug
scenes.behind: tall shelves of books with rolling ladders, a balcony with a carved railing, tall arched windows letting in soft daylight, a big globe on a stand
scenes.left: a tall bookshelf with a wooden ladder
scenes.right: a wooden reading desk with a stack of closed books
scenes.avoid: open or flying books, ink, lamps, lanterns or whales

scenes.name: Clock Tower
scenes.scene: high inside an old clock tower full of giant gears
scenes.ground: a flat floor of thick wooden planks
scenes.behind: huge interlocking brass and copper gears, the back of a big round clock face seen from inside with daylight through it, wooden beams, ropes and pulleys
scenes.left: a tall iron pendulum hanging still
scenes.right: a stack of wooden crates beside a workbench
scenes.avoid: birds, robots, buttons, rust, or numbers on the clock

scenes.name: Starry Observatory
scenes.scene: the stone terrace of a mountaintop observatory at dusk
scenes.ground: smooth stone tiles of the terrace
scenes.behind: a deep blue evening sky with the first stars and a thin crescent moon, the observatory's dome with a long telescope, a sea of clouds and far peaks in the last pink light
scenes.left: a brass telescope on a tall tripod
scenes.right: a stone balustrade post with a potted plant
scenes.avoid: shooting stars, star patterns shaped like figures, dragons, or jellyfish

scenes.name: Stormy Peak
scenes.scene: a rocky mountain summit under a dramatic stormy sky
scenes.behind: jagged peaks, a distant smoking volcano, swirling gray and purple storm clouds with gaps of warm sunlight breaking through
scenes.avoid: lightning, lava, fire, glowing cracks or dragons
